Here’s what users see when the server is running:

- **`/` — Live studio** (main UI at `http://localhost:3000`)
  - **Header**
    - LiveBridge brand + “Decart live studio”
    - Status badge: Checking setup / Setup required / Ready / Connecting / Live / Needs attention
  - **Page title**
    - “Live studio” + short blurb
    - “Decart-hosted inference” badge
  - **Alerts** (when relevant)
    - Yellow: missing env vars (live start disabled)
    - Red: error message
  - **Live preview panel**
    - Session timer / “CAMERA NOT CONNECTED”
    - **Camera input** video (or placeholder)
    - **Transformed output** video (or placeholder)
    - Camera dropdown
    - Mic on/off switch
    - **Start live** / **End session** button
  - **Reference image panel**
    - Dropzone: drop / paste / browse (empty state)
    - Or: preview + filename + size + status badge
    - Replace / Apply to live / Clear
  - **Live mode panel**
    - Segmented control: **Character** | **Restyle** | **Try-on**
  - **Your OBS link panel**
    - OBS Browser Source URL + **Copy**
    - Or: “set OBS_KEY…” message if not configured
  - **Session status panel**
    - Connected / Ready / Setup / Checking + timer when live
  - **Footer note** about Decart processing

- **`/obs?key=…` — OBS output page** (blank-looking Browser Source)
  - Full-screen video only (AI feed)
  - Blank until you press **Start live** on the studio
  - Optional small playback message if autoplay is blocked
  - Wrong/missing key → stays blank

**Typical first visit:** header + studio layout with empty camera/output placeholders, reference dropzone, mode selector (Character by default), OBS link (if `OBS_KEY` is set), and Start live disabled until env setup is complete.
